plans.idea: Left-aligned editorial stack: a big two-line headline sits in the upper-middle of the canvas and the Shop pill sits directly under it on the same left edge, so one clean left axis carries the eye from message to action.

Centred poster: the headline is set large and centred in the optical middle, with the Shop pill centred beneath it on the same vertical axis, giving a symmetric square block with even breathing room above and below.

Diagonal tension: an oversized headline fills the top-left as the dominant statement, and the Shop pill anchors the bottom-right corner, so the eye travels corner to corner and both pieces lock to the content-box edges.
